name: De Aar
story: De Aar makes the railway itself the story: connections to different regions helped shape this Northern Cape town.
history: Northern Cape Tourism describes De Aar as a major rail junction linking Johannesburg, Cape Town, Port Elizabeth and Namibia.

experience.activity: Explore the town’s Garden of Remembrance as part of a separately planned visit.
